name: Inbox
description: What your agents tell you, in one place: a coding agent finished or is waiting for you (toasts, a badge, the Mac's notifications), and results to review (an agent's research, a clipped page) as files in Inbox/ to mark done (into Inbox/.archive/) or file away.
forAgents: Something for the user to read later (research, a summary) goes in their inbox: `inbox.add`.

toasts.label: Toasts
toasts.description: a toast for each new event or result, with Open

notifications.label: Mac notifications
notifications.description: the Mac's notification while the desktop app is in the background

push.label: Phone notifications
push.description: each new event on the iPhone app's notifications (and so the watch's), with Approve and Deny when an agent asks permission; needs push set up on this machine (vau docs inbox)

turns.label: Agents' finished turns
turns.description: a coding agent ending its turn (Claude Code finished): it may still be working (a subagent, a background task), so by default it's kept read, with no toast or push; its report (vau inbox report) or vau notify says when the work is done. Waiting for you and permission asks always notify

dispatch.label: Voice notes go to
dispatch.description: the agent a voice note (from the watch, the phone or the app) starts with it (claude, codex, claude_personal...), in a new terminal; empty: they're only kept in the inbox

dispatch_prompt.default:
A voice note from the user, dictated on their watch, phone or computer (names and words may be misheard). It's in the inbox as `{path}`, named after its first words. What they said:

{text}

You're the front door, and the user isn't watching. First name the note for what it's about, in a few words: `vau move "{path}" "{folder}/<Title>.md"`. Then work out what it asks for and see it through:
- Something to remember or write down: write it in the vault (vau) and tell the user in one line (vau notify, with --action-open for what to look at).
- A task (code, research, a fix): do it all the way, by the rules of where it's done (a repo's CLAUDE.md); anything outward-facing (messages, posts, purchases) or that can't be undone, don't: ask instead. End it with `vau inbox report` (its work and a TL;DR in plain words, what you did, open questions, screenshots of what changed: vau inbox report --help); the user's reply comes back here.

Last, archive the note: `vau inbox done "{folder}/<Title>.md"` (not by editing its status, which leaves it in the inbox).
dispatch_prompt.label: Voice note prompt
dispatch_prompt.description: what that agent is told with a voice note: {path} is the note in the inbox, {folder} its folder, {text} what was said

show_read.label: Show read events
show_read.description: read events from the last day stay in the lists, greyed out, the rest behind Show N earlier; off, the inbox shows only what needs you (unread events, results to review), and the Inbox page has the read ones folded under Read

keep_days.label: Days to keep events
keep_days.description: how long agents' events are kept on this machine

reply.description: a reply box under an agent's report: what's typed goes back into its session (its terminal, the session resumed while its context is cached, or a new session that reads the report), and the report is done

inbox.description: what's new: results to review in Inbox/ and the agents' latest events
inbox.live: agents' events on this machine and the vault's other machines (not in the vault)

events.description: how many of the latest events to show (unread ones always are; read ones only with the setting show_read, greyed out, the rest folded into Show N earlier; 0 hides them)

results.description: how many results to review to show (0 hides them)
